players.bio: Alessandro Ciranni (born 28 June 1996) is a Belgian professional footballer who plays as a right-back for Dutch Eerste Divisie club Willem II. Club career Ciranni was born in Genk. After spending half a season on loan at Dutch Eerste Divisie side MVV from his parent club Genk, he signed a two-year contract with the South Limburgers in summer 2016.
Amine Et-Taïbi (born 5 February 2003) is a professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Dutch Eredivisie club Willem II. Born in Belgium, he is a youth international for Morocco.

Amine Lachkar is a 23-year-old professional football player from the Netherlands who plays as a defensive midfielder for the Dutch club Willem II. Born on 18 April 2003, in Amsterdam, he is known for his defensive presence on the pitch, standing 1.89 metres tall.

Anass Zarrouk is a 20-year-old Dutch-Moroccan professional football player who plays as a midfielder for the Dutch club Willem II Tilburg. Born on 18 July 2006 in Arnhem, Netherlands, he is known as a versatile, technically skilled midfielder capable of playing defensive, central, or attacking roles.
Armin Ćulum (born 5 November 2003) is a Swedish professional footballer who plays as a forward for Dutch club Willem II in the Eerste Divisie.

Calvin Twigt (born 30 January 2003) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Eredivisie club Go Ahead Eagles. Club career Twigt started his youth career with SC Buitenveldert before moving to the academy of FC Volendam. On 12 September 2020, he made his debut for Jong FC Volendam in the Tweede Divisie in the 0–3 away loss to Rijnsburgse Boys.
Chidozie Obi-Martin (born 29 November 2007) is a Danish footballer who plays as a forward for Premier League club Manchester United.
Devin Haen (born 18 June 2004) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a striker for Eredivisie club Willem II.
Eser Gürbüz is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a winger for the Eredivisie club Heerenveen.
Finn Stam (born 13 April 2003) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Eredivisie club Willem II.[
Hidde Willem ter Avest (born 20 May 1997) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a right-back for Eredivisie club Willem II.

Jaden Fernando Slory (born 9 May 2005) is a Dutch footballer who plays as a winger for Eredivisie club Willem II on loan from Feyenoord. Career Slory joined the Feyenoord Academy in 2013. In 2021, he signed a three-year contract with Feyenoord. As he entered the final year of his contract, Slory had trained with the Feyenoord first team without making his first team debut.
Jari Schuurman van Klaveren (born 22 February 1997) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Eredivisie club Willem II.

Jens Mathijsen is an 18-year-old Dutch professional footballer who plays as a defender (centre-back) for the Eredivisie club Willem II. Born on 15 August 2007, he is widely recognized as the son of former Netherlands national team defender Joris Mathijsen.
John Stegeman (born 27 August 1976) is a Dutch professional football manager and former footballer who is the manager of Eredivisie club Willem II.

Justin Hoogma (born 11 June 1998) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Willem II. Career Hoogma had his breakthrough in the 2016–2017 season, becoming the youngest player ever to not have missed a single minute in a full Eredivisie season, playing all 34 matches for Heracles Almelo.

Karst de Leeuw is a 22-year-old Dutch professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for the Eredivisie club Willem II Tilburg. Born on 19 April 2004, he is considered a rising young talent in the Netherlands. He stands out for his calm composure under pressure and strong shot-stopping abilities.
Kasper Boogaard (born 29 January 2006) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Eredivisie club Willem II on loan from AZ Alkmaar. He is a Dutch youth international.

Maxim Dekker (born 21 April 2004) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Eredivisie team AZ Alkmaar. A youth academy graduate of AZ, Dekker signed his first professional contract with the club in August 2020. He made his professional debut for Jong AZ on 30 April 2021 in a 1–0 league win against Roda JC Kerkrade.

Maxime Delanghe (born 23 May 2001) is a Belgian footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Cercle Brugge. Club career On 4 August 2022, Delanghe signed a one-year contract with Lierse with an option to extend for the second year. On 15 June 2023, Delanghe signed for Belgian Pro League club Cercle Brugge on a two-year contract with the option for a further year.
Nathan Noël Romejo Tjoe-A-On is a professional footballer who plays as a left-back or defensive midfielder for Eerste Divisie club Willem II.

Per van Loon is a 21-year-old Dutch professional footballer who plays primarily as a left-back for the Eredivisie club Willem II. Born on 31 December 2004, he wears jersey number 22 and came through the youth ranks at TOGB before joining Willem II.
Thomas Didillon-Hödl (born 28 November 1995) is a French professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Dutch Eredivisie club Willem II.

Thomas Jacco Verheydt (born 24 January 1992) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a forward for Eredivisie club Willem II. Born in The Hague and after youth spells with Wilhelmus, Feyenoord and ADO Den Haag, Verheydt joined Topklasse side Jodan Boys in 2012, making his debut during their 2–1 victory over IJsselmeervogels, in which he scored in the 39th minute.

Tonny Emilio Trindade de Vilhena (born 3 January 1995), known as Tonny Vilhena, is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Italian side Salernitana, on loan from Spanish club Espanyol.

Uriël van Aalst is a 19-year-old Dutch professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for the Eredivisie club Willem II. Born on 18 August 2006 in Veldhoven, Netherlands, he is widely regarded as one of the club's most promising young talents.

Vito van Crooij (born 29 January 1996) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a winger, primarily on the left hand side for Eredivisie club NEC. He won the Eerste Divisie Young Player of the Year in 2016 for his performances for VVV-Venlo. His brother, Delano van Crooy plays professionally as a goalkeeper.

Wouter van der Steen (born 3 June 1990) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for FC Den Bosch in the Dutch Eerste Divisie. He formerly played for Helmond Sport and SC Heerenveen.
